whyNow.description: a new warehouse, an expansion, or a wave of operations hiring

rationale.who: Scheduling pain is sharpest for 3PLs running several client accounts in one building.
rationale.whyNow: A new site or a hiring wave means new shifts to staff, which is when scheduling breaks.
rationale.size: Below ~100 staff a spreadsheet works; above ~1,000 they usually run an enterprise suite.
rationale.stage: Funding stage matters little for logistics operators, so no filter.
rationale.geo: Your site serves the US and UK.
rationale.recency: Three months keeps the event fresh enough to open a conversation.
rationale.exclusions: National carriers and giants already run enterprise tools.

whyNow.description: a new depot or a wave of driver and dispatch hiring
